# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Zoe with a custom-made model after Sia Siao's original concept for Bee Zoe.

This mod was created after Sia Siao's original concept for Bee Zoe which you can find here: [https://www.artstation.com/artwork/zPJAnQ](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/zPJAnQ). Please check out her incredible work and support!

Enjoy!
